Basic chat completion via the Google Vertex AI provider using the vertex_ai/ prefix for routing — verifies the prefix is stripped before dispatching and the Gemini response is normalised to the standard OpenAI chat completion shape

```elixir title="Elixir"
api_key = System.fetch_env!("API_KEY")
{:ok, client} = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = LiterLlm.defaultclient_chat_async(client, "{\"max_tokens\":16,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Say hello in one word.\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"vertex_ai/gemini-2.0-flash\",\"temperature\":0}")
IO.inspect(result)

```
